distress.title: It sounds like this is a lot right now.
distress.body: You don't have to finish this today. If you're in danger or thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, US) or call 911. If you'd rather talk to someone at the clinic, call the front desk.

llm_unavailable.title: I'm having trouble responding.
llm_unavailable.body: The assistant isn't answering right now. You can try again, or answer a few short questions in a form instead. Nothing you've entered is lost.

upload_failed.title: That photo was hard to read. That's okay.
upload_failed.body: Your photo has been deleted. You can try one more photo in even light with the card flat, or type your details instead. Both ways work.

ocr_low_confidence.title: Please check what we read.
ocr_low_confidence.body: Some details from your photo may be wrong. Fields marked "From your photo" need a quick look before you continue.

booking_conflict.title: Times are filling fast.
booking_conflict.body: Those times were taken while you were choosing. You can pick another time below, or call the front desk and they'll book you.

long_pause.title: Take your time.
long_pause.body: Your progress is saved. You can keep going whenever you're ready, or save and finish later.
